# ethereum-optimism/infra Daily Update (Mar 2, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day's development focused on minor infrastructure updates, specifically addressing deprecated aliases and backends in `mise.toml`. Several issues related to Kona and op-node discrepancies, as well as potential denial-of-service vulnerabilities, saw active discussion and volunteer offers for resolution.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Infrastructure Tooling Updates
A fix was implemented to update deprecated aliases and backends within the `mise.toml` configuration file, ensuring compatibility and removing warnings. ([#556](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/556))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Deprecation of op-geth Support
The issue concerning Flashblocks support within Geth was closed due to the deprecation of `op-geth`, rendering the feature no longer relevant. ([#756](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/756))

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were opened today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Kona Protocol Discrepancies and Vulnerabilities
Discussions continued on several Kona-related issues. For [#19340], concerning orphaned sources in `kona-derive`, a volunteer offered to fix the issue, but it was noted that a PR already exists for this. Regarding [#19333] (Kona and op-node brotli channel disagreements), [#19334] (unknown batch type panics in `kona-protocol`), and [#19335] (Kona frame parsing mismatch), a developer offered to work on these issues, requesting more details for [#19335].

### L2CM Access Control
For [#19313], which addresses adding `ProxyAdminOwnedBase` access control to predeploy `initialize()` functions, the latest comment suggests finding the corresponding PR in L1 contracts to use as a guide for implementation.
